title: How to organise the baby clothing zone | Nursery
description:
Holds the sizes your baby fits this month and moves everything else out of the house fast.

This is the Baby Clothing Zone in the Nursery. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Each drawer holds one size only with the size written on the drawer front, sleepers and bodysuits filed upright so you read every collar from above, a next-size bin on the closet shelf, and an outgoing bag on the door hook with something already in it.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Hold up each garment and read the size on the label rather than judging by eye, then check it against the size
Straighten: One size per drawer, largest size in the lowest drawer, and file sleepers upright on their spines so you can s
Shine: Empty each drawer down to the base and wipe it out, because baby drawers collect sock lint and dried spit-up i
Safety: Bolt the chest of drawers to the wall and never leave two drawers open at once, because an open drawer turns t
Standardize: A written size label on the front of every drawer, changed the same day the size changes, so anyone dressing y
Sustain: The moment a snap will not close over the diaper, that garment goes into the outgoing bag rather than the wash

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One size per drawer, and outgrown clothing never spends a night in the room.
